output.headline: Health systems led by Advocate Health and UPMC, plus provider-focused sponsors, form the buyer universe; upper-quartile pricing is defensible and strategics can pay it.
sentences: Call Advocate Health first (5 deals in the sub-sector, closed $436M), then UPMC; the order among the sponsors, Nordic Capital first, is close to a tie (back-test 28% versus 20% random). [E:tier1, E:sponsor_ordering]
Upper-quartile pricing of 15.3x EBITDA is defensible given the 16.8% margin; strategics can pay it, while sponsors reach only $193M, or $216M with a platform exit. [E:valuation, E:lbo, E:tier1]

The review removed Steward Health Care (Chapter 11) and folded Atrium Health into Advocate Health; Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners stay in the second list pending confirmation of their appetite for tech-enabled services. [E:review, E:tier2]
Most buyers share one motive: geographic expansion, cited in 90% of 284 provider deals, so lead outreach with the target's Midwest footprint. [E:motives]
